correctness.rationale: For n>=2, alpha,r in (0,1), write x=h e+sqrt(1-h²)v. The map becomes (f(h),-v) with f=(alpha-h)/sqrt((alpha-h)²+r²(1-h²)), derivative strictly negative. The unique fixed h is alpha/(1+r). The exact period-two factorization is [alpha-(1+r)h][alpha-(1-r)h][alpha²+r²-1]/alpha², with the second candidate invalid because the required positive norm would be -r. An increasing f² has no longer scalar periodic orbits, and monotone iteration plus explicit pole/latitude multipliers gives basin exchange at alpha²+r²=1. Invariant measures away from resonance are mixtures of symmetric pole pair and latitude antipodal pairs, all singular against surface measure. At resonance f(h)=(alpha-h)/(1-alpha h), f²=id, surface Jacobian [r/(1-alpha h)]^n and symmetrization gives rho=(1+J_F)/2. Independent SymPy symbolic identity check and source verifier reading support the algebra.
